mapper.update: UPDATE document_chunk SET keyword_text=#{terms},keyword_analyzer=#{analyzer}, keyword_content_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(content,'UTF8')),'hex') WHERE id=#{id} AND content=#{content} AND chunk_type='CHILD' AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: SELECT id,content FROM document_chunk WHERE chunk_type='CHILD' AND NOT deleted AND (keyword_analyzer<>#{analyzer} OR keyword_content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(content,'UTF8')),'hex')) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
